get_amiibo.description: Get one amiibo by its 16-digit ID or its name, with its character, series, type, pictures and release dates, and every 3DS, Wii U, Switch and Switch 2 game it works with: what it unlocks or does in each, and whether the game saves data to it. A name several amiibo share fails, naming them with their IDs.

description: Look up amiibo, Nintendo's figures, cards, yarn figures, bands and blocks that unlock things in games, in AmiiboAPI, the free community database of every one: more than 900 amiibo, each with its character, game series, amiibo series, type, the 16-digit ID its NFC chip carries, pictures and release dates in North America, Japan, Europe and Australia, and every 3DS, Wii U, Switch and Switch 2 game it works with, with what it unlocks or does in each. List and filter amiibo by name, character, series, type or release date, get one with its games, pick one at random, find the amiibo that work with a game, and list the games, characters, series and types. No API key needed.
